title: cap.resource/v1 — telemetry resource attributes
description: Identity every process attaches to all of its logs, metrics and traces (WP-OBS-001; 01 Item 47 §11–§12, Item 43 §4–§7). OpenTelemetry semantic-convention names where one exists, the cap.* namespace for project identities.

service.name.description: ServiceName: logical deployable or platform component, kebab-case (for example manufacturing-core, otel-collector).

service.version.description: ServiceVersion: package or image version of the running code.

service.instance.id.description: Distinguishes replicas or processes of the same service.

deployment.environment.name.description: EnvironmentID (Item 43 §5), for example local-yavuz, integration-main, eval-rc090-001.

cap.environment.class.description: EnvironmentClass (Item 43 §4). CI_EPHEMERAL is a technical CI runtime, not a team environment.
